chunks: And yet the wicked follow their own lusts without understanding. Who can show the way to those whom God allows to go astray? None will they have to help them.

key_terms.أَضَلَ اللَّهُ: whom God allows to go astray

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for those who follow their desires without knowledge?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the contrast between blind following of desires (hawā) and adherence to divine knowledge (ʿilm), often linking the 'those who wronged' to the Ahl al-Baṭin or those who neglected the guidance of the Imams. The rhetorical question emphasizes God's absolute sovereignty in guidance and misguidance, underscoring that without divine aid, the misguided are left without a protector. This serves as a warning against intellectual arrogance and the necessity of aligning one's will with God's command through the Imams.
